text: Your turn: which idiom fits? One: the new manager is, blank; nobody knows what she's capable of yet. A white elephant, a piece of cake, a dark horse, or in hot water? Two: the team was, blank, after the sudden resignation; nobody knew who was in charge. At sixes and sevens, on cloud nine, in the nick of time, or at the eleventh hour? Three: he finally, blank, and told the board the truth about the losses. Sat on the fence, bit the bullet, beat about the bush, or cut corners?
